main_text.p: enim verbis numero & sensu respondent, interpres enim ille omni paraphrasi ab-stinet, neque tantum sensum sensui red-dit, verum etiam dictiones numerat, ita ut versioni suae plures non inserat dictio-nes, quàm in prototypo reperiantur, atque ubique nomina nominibus, verba verbis, conjunctiones conjunctionibus, &c. interpretatur, quo sane interpreta-tionis genere nullum est exactius. Tam accurata interpretandi Religio Talmu-distarum sententiam confirmat, qui Sa-maritanos, quos Butaeos vocant τοῖς קרא[?] adnumerant, hoc est, Haereti-cis quibusdam, qui traditiones nullas ad-mittunt, aridaeque literae mordicus ad-haerent; quaedam suberant errata in sche-dula tua, quae facile correxi, prius ex-cerptum ex primo cap. Geneseos duas voces in unam miscebat, & in fine tres posterius ex initio 15. cap. Exodi semel resch habebat: scriptum pro beth & rur-sum resch pro dalet; si fragmentum a-liud ex Pentateucho tuo vulgari Samari-tano ad me iterum mittas[?], securius de com-

page.notes: The Greek τοῖς is clear. The Hebrew after it is partly legible (קרא), but the final letters are obscured by a printed box-like glyph, so the word is marked [?]. The word "mittas" is partly covered by an ink blot; the reading is inferred from the visible letters "as" and marked [?]. The shadowed strip on the right of the scan is show-through and scanner shading, not transcribed. No catchword or signature is visible at the foot.
